question: What did Jesus do after entering Jerusalem and looking around at everything in the temple courts?
options: He stayed the night in the temple
He drove out the sellers that night
He went up to the Mount of Olives to pray
Since it was late, he went out to Bethany with the twelve
explanation: Jesus entered Jerusalem and went into the temple courts. He looked around at everything, but since it was already late, he went out to Bethany with the twelve.
